import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { artistCredit } from "../../../backend/schema/artist_credit";

export const artistCreditCms = customizeTable<typeof artistCredit>("artist_credit", {
    display: {
        title: "name"
    },
    sort: ["created", "desc"],
    listFields: ["id", "name", "gid", "artistCount", "refCount", "editsPending"],
    fields: {
        name: {
            multiline: true
        },
        created: {
            readOnly: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: ["id", "name", "gid", "artistCount", "refCount", "editsPending", "created"]
});
